faithfulness.note: Geometry only. The registered geometry resolves with its claim class. The description states no pricing, so the label of each run names the pricing the run resolves. A run that declares a physics profile or constants is priced under them, and one that declares neither refuses absolute area, energy and latency by name.

unstated.note: The source states no weight precision (its Table II lists the crossbar size and count only); the registered geometry's 8 bits are the description's assumption.
The source states no weight storage format. The source states no count of cells per weight.
The source states no ReRAM cell precision.
The source states no bias handling; the registered geometry's bias row is the description's assumption.
The source states no activation precision; the deployment declares the grid.
Each PE carries ADCs (Section III, Fig. 3) of no stated resolution; the deployment declares the converter law.
